item: Kitchen sink — Kohler Whitehaven 33″ white farmhouse
notes: Enameled cast iron, white. 32-11/16″ × 21-9/16″ overall, 9-5/8″ tall; bowl 27¾″ × 18-1/16″ × 8-13/16″ deep; offset 3-5/8″ drain; Self-Trimming apron overlaps the cabinet face. Fits a 33″+ apron base (ours is 36″); spec sheet wants ≥9″ from cabinet top to top of door. Because the apron sits in front of the 24″ cabinet face, roughly 5–6″ of stone remains between the backsplash and the back of the bowl; enough for a single-hole faucet (confirm with the fabricator). Buy before the cabinet maker builds the base and before countertop templating. (Runner-up: Dickinson K-6546-0, $1,209.99.)

item: Kitchen faucet — Kohler Crue pull-down, brushed brass
notes: Single-hole (deck plate included for 3-hole; not needed). 17-3/16″ tall, 8-9/16″ reach, 2½″ base, 1-5/16″ hole, 1.5 gpm, side lever. Fits the ~5–6″ of stone behind the Whitehaven bowl. Check the lever swing against the window sill/trim. Price is Home Depot 2026-09-28 ($625.31); confirm before ordering.

item: Soap dispenser — Kohler Contemporary, brushed brass
notes: Deck-mount, 16 oz, refills from above. 1-1/16″ hole, 2″ flange, 3-7/16″ reach, fits decks up to 2″.
